content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves a link collision by citing the challenger's chain answer in DR3 against the defender's chain answers in CR2 and CR3, so K-C's chain-against-chain requirement governs.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"\"weighs chain against chain by footing\": one reading requires explicit comparative footing in the written grading; the other permits a chain-level underdetermined result without itemized footing.","why":"The judge text frames the issue as the challenger's DR3 chain against the defender's CR2/CR3 chain and declares the link underdetermined, not as a verse-by-verse failure to state the contrary."}
